sql.orgType.getAllForCompany: select ot.*, parent.org_type as org_parent_type, ol.level from flow.org_type ot left join flow.org_type parent on parent.id = ot.org_parent_type_id inner join flow.org_level ol on ol.id = ot.org_level_id where ot.company_id = :companyId order by ol.level, ot.org_type
sql.orgType.getSchedulableForCompany: select distinct ot.*, parent.org_type as org_parent_type, ol.level from flow.org_type ot left join flow.org_type parent on parent.id = ot.org_parent_type_id inner join flow.org_level ol on ol.id = ot.org_level_id inner join flow.org o on o.org_type_id = ot.id and o.schedulable is true and o.archived is not true where ot.company_id = :companyId order by ot.org_type
sql.orgType.getOne: select ot.*, parent.org_type as org_parent_type, ol.level from flow.org_type ot left join flow.org_type parent on parent.id = ot.org_parent_type_id inner join flow.org_level ol on ol.id = ot.org_level_id where ot.id = :id
sql.orgType.updateOrgType: update flow.org_type set org_type = :orgType, org_parent_type_id = :orgParentTypeId, org_level_id = :orgLevelId, archived = :archived, available_to_children = :availableToChildren, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.orgType.insertOrgType: insert into flow.org_type(org_type, org_parent_type_id, org_level_id, company_id, created_by_id, available_to_children) values (:orgType, :orgParentTypeId, :orgLevelId, :companyId, :createdById, :availableToChildren)
sql.orgType.updateOrgLevel: update flow.org_level set level_name = :levelName, level = :level where id = :id
sql.orgType.insertOrgLevel: insert into flow.org_level(company_id, level, level_name) values (:companyId, :level, :levelName)
